title: SBD ids.json
description: Stable line IDs for script.fountain and the ordered list of shots with the lines (or, since 0.2, the character ranges) each shot covers. The order of `shots` is the story order.

script_hash.description: Hash of script.fountain when ids.json was last written (cyrb53, 14 hex chars). A mismatch means the script was edited by hand and line IDs must be re-anchored.

lines.description: One entry per anchorable script line, ordered by ordinal.
Line IDs covered (fully or, for the first and last line with start/end, partly) by the shot, in script order. May be empty.

start.description: Format 0.2: the shot starts at this character of its first line (default: the start of the line). `line` must be the first entry of `lines`.

end.description: Format 0.2: the shot ends before this character of its last line (exclusive; default: the end of the line). `line` must be the last entry of `lines`.

type.description: Fountain element type: scene_heading, action, parenthetical, dialogue, transition, centered, lyrics.

offset.description: Character offset in the line's text (UTF-16 code units; markers and inline notes not counted).
